images.title: Studio interior — drum kit, amps, monitors
images.alt: Wide shot of the Resonant Studios live room — wooden walls with acoustic foam, a drum kit centred on a patterned rug, monitors and amps either side, mics on stands, warm overhead lighting.
images.notes: Hero image for the design system landing. Sets the warm, hand-tooled, real-room register.

images.title: Tony at the console — hero, wide
images.alt: Wide shot of Tony at the analogue mixing console wearing a navy t-shirt and headphones, smiling as he adjusts a fader. The live room visible behind the glass — drum kit, amp, mic on stand.
images.notes: Alternate hero. Most warmth + most movement of the founder shots.

images.title: Studio side — wood paneling, monitors, console edge
images.alt: Side view of the Resonant Studios live room — vertical timber slat acoustic panels, large studio monitors on stands, edge of the console visible in the foreground, warm overhead lighting on the walls.
images.notes: Section divider between Voice and Examples.

images.title: Live room — drum kit with acoustic treatment
images.alt: Wide view of the studio live room — wooden walls, slat acoustic panels and foam squares, drum kit on a rug, monitors and amps to the side, warm overhead spots.
images.notes: Section divider between Accessibility and Library.

images.title: Control room — full environment
images.alt: Wide environmental shot of the control room — Tony in navy blazer at a large analogue console, NS-10 monitors and a big main monitor on the wood-panelled wall, Aeron chair, glass through to the live room behind.
images.notes: The most editorial environmental shot. Use for For Support Coordinators / About / capability pages.

images.title: Motion-blur figure passing the console
images.alt: A figure walks past the analogue console with intentional motion blur, the outboard rack and console crisp on either side, wooden slat wall behind. Captures the working-studio movement.
images.notes: Use for transitional / divider moments where you want a sense of movement without identifying anyone.

images.title: Tony at the desk · participant on guitar behind
images.alt: Tony Rako sitting at a large analogue mixing console, headphones around his neck, smiling as he adjusts a fader. A participant in the live room behind plays an acoustic guitar through the glass.
images.notes: Used as the divider between the Foundations and Components sections. Captures the working studio register — real desk, real session, two people.

images.title: Tony at the console with a participant on guitar
images.alt: Tony at the console smiling, a condenser mic on the right, with a participant playing acoustic guitar in the live room behind through the glass. Warm wood walls.
images.notes: Variant of founder-client.jpg, slightly different framing. Use when the wider session-energy shot is needed.

images.title: Tony headshot — navy blazer, terracotta polo
images.alt: Studio headshot of Tony Rako — bald, navy blazer over a terracotta polo, neutral expression, vertical timber slat wall behind.
images.notes: Canonical About / Bio portrait. Use on For Support Coordinators, About, leadership pages.

images.title: Tony portrait — window-light
images.alt: Editorial portrait of Tony in a green cardigan against vertical timber slats, soft venetian-blind shadows of warm window light falling across the wall behind him.
images.notes: Best for storytelling / editorial layouts. The shadow play makes it a strong hero alt.

images.title: Tony portrait — three-quarter profile
images.alt: Three-quarter profile portrait of Tony in a navy blazer over a tan textured polo, warm wood backdrop. Calm, considered expression.
images.notes: Pairs well with participant testimonials — quiet, listening register.

images.title: Tony portrait — synth and piano either side
images.alt: Tony seated head-on in a green cardigan, vintage analogue synthesizer to one side and an upright electric piano keyboard to the other, vertical timber slat wall behind.
images.notes: Strong founder-credibility shot. Conveys hands-on producer.

images.title: Tony at the console — seated portrait
images.alt: Tony seated at a large analogue mixing console wearing a navy blazer and terracotta polo, NS-10 monitors flanking him, control-room glass through to the live room behind.
images.notes: Polished founder-headshot variant. Best for For Support Coordinators landing.

images.title: Tony mixing — profile, headphones
images.alt: Tony at the console in profile, wearing headphones and a beige jumper, hands on faders, fully focused. Wood-panelled wall and live-room glass behind.
images.notes: Working-session portrait. Use for process / how-it-works pages.

images.title: Tony hands-on — console knobs
images.alt: Cropped shot of Tony at the console, his hand on the channel knobs, wearing a navy blazer over a tan polo. Cropped at the chin so the focus is on the work.
images.notes: Good detail crop for strip / band sections.

images.title: Tony at the drum kit — headphones, sticks
images.alt: Tony at the drum kit in profile, headphones on, sticks in hand, wearing a forest-green jumper. Wooden walls behind.
images.notes: Drumming session portrait. Use when illustrating skill-building or instrument coaching.

images.title: Tony at the vocal booth — condenser mic
images.alt: Tony in the vocal booth standing at a condenser microphone with pop filter, wearing studio headphones and a navy cardigan over a grey shirt.
images.notes: Vocal-take portrait. Use when illustrating recording / tracking sessions.

images.title: Guitar amplifier heads
images.alt: Two guitar amplifier heads stacked — a vintage tube amp on top of a 5150 head — sitting on speaker cabinets on a wooden floor with a rug edge visible.
images.notes: Section divider between Voice and Accessibility.

images.title: Cymbal stand · drum kit detail
images.alt: Close-up of a cymbal mounted on a chrome boom stand, with a snare drum and seat behind, all on a patterned rug. Wooden walls in the background.
images.notes: Section divider between Components and Voice.

images.title: Hand on a fader — VU-meter console
images.alt: Close-up of a hand placing fingers on a fader cap on a vintage analogue console. Three VU meters sit at the top of the frame, knob field stretches into the background.
images.notes: Excellent texture shot. Use for capability / craft callouts.

images.title: Walnut kick-drum shell — detail
images.alt: Close-up of a walnut DW kick drum shell with chrome lugs and tuning rods, the natural wood grain catching warm light.
images.notes: Strong wood-grain texture. Pairs with brand register.

images.title: Abalone snare shell — top down
images.alt: Top-down detail of a DW snare with an iridescent abalone-finish shell — blue and copper flecks shimmer through black hardware lugs.
images.notes: Adds a colourful, almost jewel-like accent to grids of texture shots.

images.title: Tube amp control panel — VOL, BASS, TREBLE, REVERB
images.alt: Close-up of a vintage tube amp control panel — chrome knobs labelled VOL, BASS, TREBLE, TREBLE, REVERB, LOW, with the woven grille cloth visible below.
images.notes: Classic Fender-style amp face. Useful as a small inline detail.

images.title: Combo amp on the studio floor
images.alt: A black combo guitar amp with grey woven grille and chrome corners sits on a wooden floor with a patterned rug edge visible. A mic stand is in the soft-focus background.
images.notes: Calm, well-composed equipment shot. Good for lifestyle / setup pages.

images.title: Studio monitor cone — close
images.alt: Close-up of a black studio monitor — woofer cone visible at an angle, fabric-covered baffle texture in focus, warm wood wall behind.
images.notes: Texture shot. Pairs with kick-drum-walnut-detail in a grid.

images.title: Outboard rack — preamp + amp faceplates
images.alt: Close-up of an outboard rack — preamp, amp 1, and tuner faceplates with chrome screws, dark anodised metal panels, slight depth-of-field falloff into the rest of the rack.
images.notes: Conveys depth of gear without identifying brands. Good for capability pages.

images.title: Mic-stand foot, cable, monitor — rug detail
images.alt: Detail shot at floor level — base of a black mic-stand with coiled XLR cable, the corner of a monitor speaker beside it, all on a patterned blue and red rug.
images.notes: Quiet still-life. Use as a calm interlude in image strips.

images.title: Patch-cable rack — preamp inputs
images.alt: Close-up of patched XLR and braided audio cables connected to preamp and outboard inputs in a black rack, with acoustic foam visible to the right.
images.notes: The 'real working studio' detail. Reads as 'we connect everything properly.' (Originally named Pickup.jpg — actually patching, not a guitar pickup.)

images.title: Vinyl record · venetian-blind shadows
images.alt: Tony in profile holding a vinyl record up to soft light, an orange 'Acoustic' label visible at the centre, with strong venetian-blind shadows striping the wall behind.
images.notes: Strong editorial mood shot. Use for blog / story / pull-quote backdrops.

images.title: Wordmark — for dark surfaces
images.alt: Resonant Studios wordmark in white, with the eighth-note R glyph and 'studios.com.au' subtitle.
images.notes: Use on dark surfaces (--bg in dark mode). The canonical wordmark.

images.title: Wordmark — for light surfaces
images.alt: Resonant Studios wordmark in black, with the eighth-note R glyph and 'studios.com.au' subtitle.
images.notes: Use on light surfaces (--bg in light mode).

images.title: Mark — for dark surfaces
images.alt: Resonant Studios mark — a stylised eighth-note R glyph, in white.
images.notes: Use as favicon, app icon, social avatar. Never under 32px.

images.title: Mark — for light surfaces
images.alt: Resonant Studios mark — a stylised eighth-note R glyph, in black.
images.notes: Use as favicon, app icon, social avatar. Never under 32px.

images.title: App icon — pale, white letter
images.alt: Rounded-square app icon — Resonant Studios R glyph in white on a pale, near-white surface.
images.notes: App-icon variant. Subtle / minimalist surface. Pairs with light-mode home screens.

images.title: App icon — dark wood, white letter
images.alt: Rounded-square app icon — Resonant Studios R glyph in white on a dark walnut wood-grain surface.
images.notes: App-icon variant. Warmest / richest dark surface. Strong against dark-mode home screens.

images.title: App icon — light wood, white letter
images.alt: Rounded-square app icon — Resonant Studios R glyph in white on a light maple wood-grain surface.
images.notes: App-icon variant. The softest, most studio-furniture register. Default for light-mode home screens.

images.title: App icon — black leather, white letter
images.alt: Rounded-square app icon — Resonant Studios R glyph in white on a black leather-textured surface.
images.notes: App-icon variant. Premium / studio-equipment register. Strong on dark surfaces.

images.title: App icon — two-tone wood, white letter
images.alt: Rounded-square app icon — Resonant Studios R glyph in white on a two-tone wood surface with a darker trim band.
images.notes: App-icon variant. Most crafted / cabinet-maker register. Use when emphasising the artisan side of the brand.

images.title: App icon — black debossed
images.alt: Rounded-square app icon — Resonant Studios R glyph debossed into a black textured surface, no colour contrast.
images.notes: App-icon variant. Quiet, monochrome. Use where the icon must recede or sit alongside other dark icons.

images.title: App icon — cream tile, black letter
images.alt: Rounded-square app icon — Resonant Studios R glyph in black on a cream stone-tile surface.
images.notes: App-icon variant. Inverted — dark glyph on light. Use as the default light-mode app icon.

images.title: App icon — black leather with wood trim, white letter
images.alt: Rounded-square app icon — Resonant Studios R glyph in white on a black leather surface with a soft wood-grain trim around the edge.
images.notes: App-icon variant. Most editorial / hi-fi-component register. Combines the leather + wood signatures.
